ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Pluto

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up home and family.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
Until {H:1827750367000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.
